content.short: AllScale is a self-custody neobank giving global businesses a dollar account and stablecoin payments.
content.description: AllScale gives businesses a global dollar account in seconds with no bank application or seed phrase, plus instant, compliant stablecoin payments, invoicing and checkout. Stable's official ecosystem page lists AllScale.
content.meta: AllScale is a self-custody neobank for business stablecoin payments, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
